intro.fr: Rabbit and Steel se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Rabbit and Steel can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: mino_dev sort Rabbit and Steel en 2024.
text.en: mino_dev releases Rabbit and Steel in 2024.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub tjwombo/RNSArchipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Rabbit and Steel.
text.en: The GitHub repository tjwombo/RNSArchipelago, home of the Rabbit and Steel APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, Alpha v0.1.1.
text.en: The first version, Alpha v0.1.1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.4.3, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (28 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.4.3 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (28 versions released).

text.fr: Rabbit and Steel figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Rabbit and Steel is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
